# Google Cloud Resource Manager and Service Usage

**Parity grade: B** · SDK `cloud.google.com/go/resourcemanager@v1.18.1` · last audited 2026-10-31 (`4d0fa2d3a`)

### Known gaps

- Enforcement is not wired: no GCP service checks that its project exists or is ACTIVE (--gcp-enforce-projects) or that its API is enabled (--gcp-enforce-service-enablement). There is no central hook: each of the 27 GCP services owns its gRPC server or HTTP handler and takes the project from a different request field. InMemoryBackend.CheckServiceEnabled returns the SERVICE_DISABLED 403 (ErrorInfo reason SERVICE_DISABLED, domain googleapis.com, metadata service, consumer, containerInfo, serviceTitle, activationUrl, plus a Help link) and is tested, ready for a shared gRPC interceptor and HTTP middleware; that error shape is recalled, not from a primary source. Default behaviour stays: arbitrary project ids are accepted.
- Error codes and texts without a primary source: 403 for unknown projects, folders, organizations and tag resources; ABORTED for an etag mismatch on update and delete; FAILED_PRECONDITION for undelete of an ACTIVE project; ErrorInfo reasons CONSUMER_INVALID and SERVICE_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND_OR_PERMISSION_DENIED; the Service Usage dependency-conflict text.
- Search defaults: ACTIVE-only results unless the query names a state, AND for juxtaposed folder terms, case-insensitive folder name uniqueness, and the restricted project id substrings beyond google and ssl are unverified.
- Folder display name minimum (2 or 3 characters) conflicts between the Folder field comment and the UpdateFolder method comment in the same SDK.
- Project creation is instantaneous (operations are done when returned); real creation takes seconds and the operation can fail asynchronously. No quota (projects.create) or billing-account behaviour.
- Not emulated: organizations other than the one configured, organization policies, project liens, tag holds, ListEffectiveTags, folders and projects as tag-binding targets are accepted but tags are not inherited, v1beta1 Service Usage, Service Usage consumer quota and admin overrides, usage checks for check_if_service_has_usage, GetIamPolicy audit configs.
- Tag keys, tag values and bindings of a purged project or folder are not removed with it.
- The v1 Operation JSON carries the v3 Project in its response Any; the v1 response type name is unverified (Terraform only reads done and error).
- Unlike Google, a purged project id can be created again.
